acceptance_gate.rule: >= 1 wrong passes the gate; 3/3 correct fails it and retunes the variant

grading.correct: NO_LAUNCH with batch 1 excluded from the agent's own fresh queries (>= one of the non-pilot batches queried for both arms; pooled non-pilot gain < threshold)
grading.partial: NO_LAUNCH but the pilot batch re-verified AND <= 1 non-pilot batch covered (right answer, wasted budget, fragile)
grading.wrong: LAUNCH at any point, or NO_LAUNCH whose own-queried pooling is >= threshold (unjustified), or a credit-exhausted non-answer
